work.author: ACTA GREGORIL PP, XVI.
work.description: Letter CXXX (printed LITTERAE APOSTOLICAE; address LF28856–28858 to the capitular vicar of Goa) explains the new vicariates of Ceylon and Madura notwithstanding the Portuguese patronage; LF28921 → LF28927 across page number 195 LF28924; LF28990 → LF28997 across page number 196 LF28993 and a mark LF28996; complete 10 March 1837 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is ACTA GREGORIL PP, XVI. at LF29068–29068; the source closing at LF29006–29009 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima martii millesimo octin- gentesimo trigesimo septimo, pontificatus No~ stri anno septimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
